_about: Every load the rifle set uses. muzzleFps is the speed from the barrel the rifle in this set actually has; where the maker measured in a different barrel the figure is an estimate by the rule stated. bc is the ballistic coefficient the engine uses with dragModel (G1 or G7); where the maker publishes both, the one the maker's own trajectory table follows is used. spreadMoa is the five-shot extreme spread in minutes of angle (MOA, 1/60 of a degree, about 1.047 inches at 100 yards) expected from that rifle and load. boxCount is the number of rounds in the box the maker sells it in: a day at the range has one box.
